import Definitions.Def_AbcTripod
import Definitions.Def_AbcRationalHeight
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod

theorem rationalABCHeight_of_statementI (hI : StatementI)
    (hdeg : DegreeOneProjection) (hdiff : LogDifferentZeroProjection)
    (hheight : HeightComparisonProjection) (hcond : RadicalConductorProjection) :
    AbcAdaptation.RationalABCHeight := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hI 1 ε hε
  refine ⟨C, fun q h0 h1 => ?_⟩
  let x := rationalPoint q h0 h1
  have hdegree : deg x.1 = 1 := hdeg q h0 h1
  have hdifferent : logDiff x = 0 := hdiff q h0 h1
  have hheight' : Height.logHeight₁ q ≤ htCan x := hheight q h0 h1
  have hconductor : logCond x ≤
      Real.log ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical
        (q.num * (q.num - (q.den : ℤ)) * (q.den : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) := hcond q h0 h1
  have hstatement := hC x hdegree.le
  have hscale : (1 + ε) * logCond x ≤
      (1 + ε) * Real.log ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical
        (q.num * (q.num - (q.den : ℤ)) * (q.den : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hconductor (le_of_lt (add_pos zero_lt_one hε))
  calc
    Height.logHeight₁ q ≤ htCan x := hheight'
    _ ≤ (1 + ε) * (logDiff x + logCond x) + C := hstatement
    _ = (1 + ε) * logCond x + C := by rw [hdifferent, zero_add]
    _ ≤ (1 + ε) * Real.log ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical
          (q.num * (q.num - (q.den : ℤ)) * (q.den : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) + C := by
      linarith [hscale]

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod
natural_language_statement:
> “Thus, it follows from the equivalence of [GenEll], Theorem 2.1, that, in order to complete the proof of Corollary 2.3, it suffices to verify that [GenEll], Theorem 2.1, (ii), holds.”

— Shinichi Mochizuki, *Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory IV*, §2, proof of Corollary 2.3.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.rationalABCHeight_of_statementI`

For every point $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}\setminus\{0,1\}$, write $F_z=\mathbb Q(z)$, let $g_z\in F_z$ map to $z$, and set $n_z=\deg(\operatorname{minpoly}_{\mathbb Q}(z))$, $H_z=\operatorname{logHeight}_{1,F_z}(g_z)/n_z$, $D_z=\log|\operatorname{discr}(F_z)|/n_z$, and $S_z=\frac1{n_z}\sum_{v\in B_z}\log\#(\mathcal O_{F_z}/\mathfrak p_v)$, where $B_z$ is exactly the finite set of finite places with $v(g_z)\ne1$ or $v(g_z-1)\ne1$. The height numerator is Mathlib's relative logarithmic height, all denominators are real casts of the point degree, and each place in the sum is counted once without extra weights. Assume $h_I$: for every $d\in\mathbb N$ and real $\varepsilon>0$, there exists real $C$ such that every such $z$ with $n_z\le d$ satisfies $H_z\le(1+\varepsilon)(D_z+S_z)+C$, with no bounded-set restriction. Assume also $h_{\mathrm{deg}},h_{\mathrm{diff}},h_{\mathrm{height}},h_{\mathrm{cond}}$: for every rational $q\ne0,1$ and every pair of proofs of these exclusions, writing $q=a/b$ in reduced form with positive $b\in\mathbb N$ and $a\in\mathbb Z$, and letting $z$ be its canonical image in $\overline{\mathbb Q}$, one respectively has $n_z=1$, $D_z=0$, $\log\max(|a|,b)=\operatorname{logHeight}_{1,\mathbb Q}(q)\le H_z$, and $S_z\le\log\operatorname{rad}_{\mathbb Z}(a(a-b)b)$. Then for every real $\varepsilon>0$ there exists $C\in\mathbb R$, uniform in $q$, such that every rational $q\ne0,1$ satisfies $\log\max(|a|,b)\le(1+\varepsilon)\log\operatorname{rad}_{\mathbb Z}(a(a-b)b)+C$. In both radical occurrences the product and radical are taken in $\mathbb Z$; the radical is the positive product of the distinct prime divisors of the absolute value of the nonzero product, cast to $\mathbb R$ before the logarithm. No sign condition is imposed on the existential constants; $h_I$ includes the vacuous degree bound $d=0$.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.rationalABCHeight_of_statementI`

对于每个点 $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}\setminus\{0,1\}$，记 $F_z=\mathbb Q(z)$，令 $g_z\in F_z$ 映到 $z$，并令 $n_z=\deg(\operatorname{minpoly}_{\mathbb Q}(z))$、$H_z=\operatorname{logHeight}_{1,F_z}(g_z)/n_z$、$D_z=\log|\operatorname{discr}(F_z)|/n_z$、$S_z=\frac1{n_z}\sum_{v\in B_z}\log\#(\mathcal O_{F_z}/\mathfrak p_v)$，其中 $B_z$ 恰为满足 $v(g_z)\ne1$ 或 $v(g_z-1)\ne1$ 的有限位组成的有限集。高度分子是 Mathlib 的相对对数高度，所有分母均为转换为实数的点次数，求和中每个有限位计一次且无额外权重。假设 $h_I$：对于每个 $d\in\mathbb N$ 和每个实数 $\varepsilon>0$，存在实数 $C$，使每个满足 $n_z\le d$ 的上述点均满足 $H_z\le(1+\varepsilon)(D_z+S_z)+C$，没有有界点集限制。另假设 $h_{\mathrm{deg}},h_{\mathrm{diff}},h_{\mathrm{height}},h_{\mathrm{cond}}$：对于每个 $q\in\mathbb Q$ 且 $q\ne0,1$，以及这两个排除条件的每一对证明，将 $q$ 写成既约分数 $a/b$，其中 $a\in\mathbb Z$、$b\in\mathbb N$ 且 $b>0$，并令 $z$ 为它在 $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 中的典范像，则分别有 $n_z=1$、$D_z=0$、$\log\max(|a|,b)=\operatorname{logHeight}_{1,\mathbb Q}(q)\le H_z$ 和 $S_z\le\log\operatorname{rad}_{\mathbb Z}(a(a-b)b)$。那么，对于每个实数 $\varepsilon>0$，存在对 $q$ 统一的实数 $C$，使每个有理数 $q\ne0,1$ 均满足 $\log\max(|a|,b)\le(1+\varepsilon)\log\operatorname{rad}_{\mathbb Z}(a(a-b)b)+C$。两处根基中的乘积和根基运算均在整数环中进行；根基是该非零乘积的绝对值的所有不同素因子的正乘积，先转换为实数，再取对数。不要求存在的常数具有任何符号；$h_I$ 也包括没有符合条件的点的次数界 $d=0$。

**日本語**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.rationalABCHeight_of_statementI`

各点 $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}\setminus\{0,1\}$ について、$F_z=\mathbb Q(z)$ とし、$g_z\in F_z$ を $z$ に移る元とする。$n_z=\deg(\operatorname{minpoly}_{\mathbb Q}(z))$、$H_z=\operatorname{logHeight}_{1,F_z}(g_z)/n_z$、$D_z=\log|\operatorname{discr}(F_z)|/n_z$、$S_z=\frac1{n_z}\sum_{v\in B_z}\log\#(\mathcal O_{F_z}/\mathfrak p_v)$ と置く。$B_z$ は $v(g_z)\ne1$ または $v(g_z-1)\ne1$ を満たす有限素点からなる、ちょうどその有限集合である。高さの分子は Mathlib の相対的な対数的高さ、各分母は実数に移した点の次数であり、和では各素点を一度だけ数え、追加の重みを付けない。$h_I$ として、すべての $d\in\mathbb N$ と実数 $\varepsilon>0$ に対し実数 $C$ が存在し、$n_z\le d$ のすべての点で $H_z\le(1+\varepsilon)(D_z+S_z)+C$ が、有界集合への制限なしに成り立つと仮定する。さらに $h_{\mathrm{deg}},h_{\mathrm{diff}},h_{\mathrm{height}},h_{\mathrm{cond}}$ として、各有理数 $q\ne0,1$ とその除外条件の各証明の組に対し、$q=a/b$ を $a\in\mathbb Z$、正の $b\in\mathbb N$ による既約表示、$z$ を $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ への標準的な像とすると、それぞれ $n_z=1$、$D_z=0$、$\log\max(|a|,b)=\operatorname{logHeight}_{1,\mathbb Q}(q)\le H_z$、$S_z\le\log\operatorname{rad}_{\mathbb Z}(a(a-b)b)$ が成り立つと仮定する。このとき、すべての実数 $\varepsilon>0$ に対し、$q$ に一様な実数 $C$ が存在し、すべての有理数 $q\ne0,1$ で $\log\max(|a|,b)\le(1+\varepsilon)\log\operatorname{rad}_{\mathbb Z}(a(a-b)b)+C$ が成り立つ。二つの根基はいずれも積と根基を整数環で計算し、非零の積の絶対値を割る相異なる素数すべての正の積を実数に移してから対数を取る。存在する定数には符号の条件がなく、$h_I$ は該当する点のない次数上限 $d=0$ も含む。
source: Shinichi Mochizuki, Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position, Theorem 2.1(i), rational-tripod specialization; Inter-universal Teichmüller Theory IV, §2, Corollary 2.3.
